name: Roy Payan
office: Los Angeles Community College District, Member of the Board of Trustees, Seat 2

items.text: Roy Payan told the Los Angeles Times he suspended his campaign for the Los Angeles Community College District Board of Trustees. In 2017, he and Portia Mason, both blind students, sued the district, saying it failed to provide accessible reading materials, note-taking assistance, and software. In 2026, the Ninth Circuit ordered the reinstatement of a $218,500 jury award to Payan in the disability discrimination case.
